mappings.label: Level 1 basic opacity new-tab trap
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: Trusted input opens an unauthorized browsing context through a transparent full-viewport target.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright checks that the unexpected page does not survive and that a NavSentinel intervention appears.
mappings.known_limitation: The fixture has no independent sink receipt and the product event remains part of the pass condition.

mappings.label: Level 2 moving target
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: The activation target materially changes between inspection and the trusted click.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright observes the blocked unexpected browsing context and product UI.
mappings.known_limitation: No independent record proves the actual inspected target, final hit target, and consequence as separate facts.

mappings.label: Level 3 instant injection
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A newly injected target changes the consequence around the user's activation.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright checks the unauthorized page is blocked and the intervention is rendered.
mappings.known_limitation: The test is one authored timing point and does not establish adjacent timing robustness.

mappings.label: Level 4 visual mimicry
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A browser-like page surface induces an action whose effective destination differs from the displayed context.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright checks the deceptive navigation outcome and product UI state.
mappings.known_limitation: The fixture models one visual surface and is not evidence of general browser-in-the-browser recognition.

mappings.label: Level 5 popunder
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: One trusted action creates an extra unauthorized browsing context.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright counts browsing contexts and checks the unexpected popup is absent.
mappings.known_limitation: The authored primitive does not cover window geometry, named reuse, or long-delay variants.

mappings.label: Level 6 programmatic click
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A page-generated activation attempts to consume authority for a user-level consequence.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright checks that the programmatic action does not produce the protected navigation.
mappings.known_limitation: Synthetic input is not inherently malicious; this primitive does not model accessibility or delegated-agent authority.

mappings.label: Level 7 legitimate modal backdrop
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: No unauthorized consequence occurs; the accessible modal must remain usable.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright completes the intended modal interaction without a NavSentinel block.
mappings.known_limitation: One fixture does not cover the full accessibility, framework, and stacking-context control space.

mappings.label: Level 8 legitimate OAuth popup
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A scoped authentication popup must complete without authorizing an unrelated second context.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright uses trusted input and verifies one legitimate popup completes without an unexpected prompt.
mappings.known_limitation: The synthetic local flow does not validate provider protocol, redirect state, or open-web OAuth compatibility.

mappings.label: Level 9 legitimate video overlay
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A legitimate foreground media control remains usable and does not create an unauthorized consequence.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright completes the intended video-overlay interaction without suppression or blocking.
mappings.known_limitation: This control does not cover embedded real-player variance or every accessible dialog pattern.

mappings.label: Level 10 redirects and forms
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A delayed navigation commits or a changed form destination receives protected input outside scoped intent.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright checks redirect recovery and form-prompt behavior through browser and product UI state.
mappings.known_limitation: Rollback is post-commit containment and the form path lacks a typed independent protected-data sink receipt.

mappings.label: Level 11 credential guard
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A synthetic password submit reaches an unexpected or insecure destination.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright checks that risky submits prompt and legitimate/trusted submits complete.
mappings.known_limitation: Product modal state is the principal oracle; the lane does not prove all script-based exfiltration sinks.

mappings.label: Level 12 slow same-tab navigation
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: No unauthorized boundary is crossed; a deliberate slow same-site navigation must remain usable.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright completes the expected navigation without an unexplained intervention.
mappings.known_limitation: One local control does not validate SSO, payment-return, shortener, or open-web delayed-navigation compatibility.

mappings.known_limitation: The test checks popup survival and product UI; it does not independently replay ad-network or search-result provenance.

mappings.label: ClickFix 01 Fake CAPTCHA sentinel
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A fake CAPTCHA writes an inert synthetic sentinel and directs the user toward an OS execution gesture.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright reads the clipboard and requires the exact inert sentinel plus the product alert; no OS paste or execution is attempted.
mappings.known_limitation: The browser cannot observe the OS paste destination or execution, so this is detection evidence rather than end-to-end prevention.

mappings.label: Phishing corpus validation
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A held-out phishing snapshot reaches its synthetic protected sink or a benign snapshot is interrupted.
mappings.current_oracle: The current lane scores product-facing corpus results from local snapshots.
mappings.known_limitation: The historical 28% run lacks the required real-host routing, trusted input, protected-vs-fired oracle, and committed manifest; #417 owns repair.

mappings.label: False-positive measurement
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A benign journey is interrupted without an independent unauthorized consequence.
mappings.current_oracle: A local measurement script counts product alerts over a user-supplied snapshot set.
mappings.known_limitation: The historical 0.72% result is stale and the required current input manifest and reproducible output are absent.

mappings.label: Rollback browser lane
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A suspicious navigation commits before local recovery returns to the prior page.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright checks the committed URL, return navigation, and forward offer.
mappings.known_limitation: This lane demonstrates post-commit containment and must never be reported as pre-harm blocking.

mappings.label: State and timing stress lane
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: Timing, restart, or tab churn causes stale authority, state leakage, or an unauthorized browsing context.
mappings.current_oracle: Serial Playwright journeys inspect browser consequences across five authored stress sequences.
mappings.known_limitation: Five fixed journeys are regression cases, not a distributional robustness campaign.

mappings.label: Live-site compatibility check
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: No unauthorized consequence is modelled; an external search journey should remain usable.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright visits a live Google result and checks that no prompt appears.
mappings.known_limitation: This network-dependent check is not hermetic, does not model harm, and is not current owner Chrome or Gate-3 evidence.

mappings.label: Default bundled-browser regression suite
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: An authored attack reaches its browser sink or an authored benign journey is interrupted.
mappings.current_oracle: Playwright checks browser and product outcomes in a persistent unpacked-extension context.
mappings.known_limitation: The build can be skipped when extension/dist is absent, and bundled Chromium is not owner Chrome or human Gate-3 proof.

mappings.label: Bridge peer document-start ordering model
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A page-owned MessageChannel peer receives the MAIN-world challenge and changes protection mode, confirmed by an independent local DOM receipt.
mappings.current_oracle: Trusted bundled Chromium requires the real extension loader, isolated capture, and verified bridge. The fixture separately records peer init, challenge, config acknowledgement, product readiness, benign input, and a typed DOM-only harm receipt.
mappings.known_limitation: The earliest normal authored-page peer received no challenge in ten fresh profiles and the post-readiness peer was also rejected. The harmful sink was not reached, so 02-ATTACK remains incomplete. Same-session replay and any genuinely page-reachable pre-page actor are unproven; privileged pre-page injection was deliberately not used.

mappings.label: Overlay lifecycle nested-context regression
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: A deceptive foreground target is reinserted or survives in a same-origin nested context after cleanup.
mappings.current_oracle: A loopback-only fake sink records the attack baseline consequence; protected attack and mixed runs require zero new sink receipts while the benign rerender remains usable.
mappings.known_limitation: The lane uses one hand-authored same-origin UI-004 sequence in Playwright-bundled Chromium; cross-origin, broad mutation, branded Chrome, and efficacy coverage remain separate.

mappings.label: Evasion fixture local-target safety contract
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: Trusted input reaches a typed local wrong-target navigation sink instead of a benign local destination.
mappings.current_oracle: A pre-launch deny proxy and typed loopback sink with one-use target authorities record the attack baseline; the qualified interaction-only release build keeps the protected and mixed harm requests out while native keyboard input completes the benign task and its nav_silent_allow event is recorded separately.
mappings.known_limitation: The exact sink receipt exercises the composite Evasion 05 control plus two deterministic one-axis CSS neighbours. The other eleven localized fixtures retain their existing product-event-coupled regression checks, and randomized DOM, text, localization, timing, viewport, and holdout robustness remain unproved.

mappings.label: Local fixture benchmark
mappings.primary_harm_boundary: An authored fixture reaches its local browser sink or a benign control is classified incorrectly.
mappings.current_oracle: A local script runs selected Gym cases and records NavSentinel event outcomes.
mappings.known_limitation: The benchmark is product-event coupled, has no independent comparator arm, and cannot support efficacy claims.
